summary.text: Brian Lorenz is a Republican state representative from Ohio House of Representatives District 60 who was appointed in May 2023 and is seeking re-election on the November 3, 2026 ballot. A former mayor and city council member of Powell, he is vice chair of the Development Committee.

paragraphs.text: Lorenz lives in Powell, Ohio, where he served as mayor and on the city council, according to Ballotpedia.
He lost the 2018 Republican primary for Ohio House District 67 to Kris Jordan.
Lorenz was appointed to the Ohio House on May 14, 2023, to replace Jordan, and he won election to the seat in 2024 by defeating Rachael Morocco.
In the 2025–2026 session he was assigned to the Development (vice chair), Insurance, Local Government and Transportation committees.
He defeated Peggy Guzzo in the Republican primary on May 5, 2026.

In a 2018 Ballotpedia survey, he listed removing the growth cap in the school funding formula, returning dollars to the county for infrastructure and keeping residents’ taxes low as his top priorities.
